# Font Intelligence

> A typography decision system and font pairing engine for AI coding agents, UI/UX designers, and developers. It replaces default fonts (Inter, Roboto, Arial) with scored, anti-pattern-checked pairings, verified weights, and copy-pasteable code tokens. Version 1.0.0, MIT licensed.

Repository: https://github.com/ratulhub/font-intelligence
Website: https://font-intelligence.vercel.app
Documentation: https://font-intelligence.vercel.app/docs
Canonical skill file: .agents/skills/font-intelligence/SKILL.md

## What it does
- Diagnoses the project against 29 use cases and translates vibe words ("expensive", "clean", "not AI-looking") into typographic terms.
- Scores font pairs on 10 weighted dimensions and applies 10 anti-pattern penalties (-15 to -45 points).
- Audits OpenType script coverage (zero-tofu policy). Bangla and Arabic return 0 catalog fonts and map to Hind Siliguri, Noto Sans Bengali, and Amiri.
- Emits only weights listed in technical.weights.
- Outputs CSS custom properties, Flutter pubspec.yaml, React Native StyleSheet, and Microsoft Office TrueType embedding guidance.
- Zero-bloat delivery: prunes unused fonts and deletes temporary skill folders from user projects upon completion.
- Catalog: 413 families, 1,083 binaries. 112 permissive families are redistributable in assets/fonts/.

## Hard rules
1. Never invent catalog fonts, weights, or language support.
2. Never equate commercial use with GitHub redistribution.
3. Respect explicit user fonts.
4. Do not replace existing typography systems.
5. No decorative fonts in body or ui roles.
6. Maximum 2 primary families (plus mono when code or data is present).
7. Readability 7/10 or higher for body and UI.
8. WOFF2 under 100 KB for web; .ttf outlines for Microsoft Office.
9. Always generate calibrated system fallbacks.
10. Zero-bloat project delivery: only used font files stay in user project repositories.

## Key commands
- python scripts/recommend.py --use-case fintech --style "expensive, not AI-looking" --platform web
- python scripts/score_pair.py --primary chillax --secondary general-sans --style luxury
- python scripts/search_fonts.py --mood "clean" --role body --min-readability 8 --script Latin
- python scripts/copy_fonts.py --fonts "chillax,general-sans" --dest "dist/fonts" --prune-unused
- python scripts/clean_project.py --project-dir path/to/project --keep-fonts "chillax,general-sans"

## Agent adapters
Antigravity, Claude Code (CLAUDE.md), Codex (AGENTS.md), Cursor (.cursorrules), Windsurf (.windsurfrules), Cline (.clinerules), GitHub Copilot (.github/copilot-instructions.md), Gemini CLI (GEMINI.md). Compact fallback: lite/font-intelligence-lite.md.
